These are source-derived fixtures from the public AppKit v0.2.4 source asset, not a running-app capture. The ledger pins its source checksum and commit. The source directory retains byte-exact evidence used to derive the preferences and recovery samples.

To reproduce, download the source asset named in ledger.json, verify its SHA-256, extract it, and compare the listed source-file hashes. preferences.json is a JSON representation of the two UserDefaults keys documented by WindowRestoration.swift and AppZoomPolicy.swift. recovery-v*.json are deterministic samples constructed using the released recovery test draft helper and released schema definitions. The tests check them through the current recovery reader. Real installed-app migration remains a native release qualification step.
